videos.title: The Most Profitable Dealer Trade Is Short Put, Short Stock, Long Call
videos.description:
Macro can be terrible, sentiment can be negative, everything can point one direction, and if it is not negative enough to accelerate real risk, the flows still win. Cem Karsan explains why the largest options expiration on record plus holiday time decay makes this a hard window to be short, where those flows peak, and why he wants January, February and March rather than December. Plus the dealer position that forces buying at every low.
